authorization: User 2026-10-29 authorizes Full dataset allocation analysis, N607 upload and experiment-data preparation. No identity training, prediction or scoring.
class_selection_rule: Exclude six source TX; require all7RX×4dates nonempty, minimum per-RX remaining count sufficient for all11domains, and fresh-support count sufficient for all11domains. Rank descending minimum four-date query-eligible total after reserving entire ManyTx, descending minimum fresh-support total after excluding all four compact datasets, descending minimum raw date count, lexical tie. Take20; fixed independent arrival permutation. No IQ quality, model or accuracy selection.
historical_policy: All new received observations exclude the entire existing ManyTx by exact float64 IQ row matching within RX/TX/date, conservatively covering the known historical Phase2 received family. New support additionally excludes the union of ManySig, ManyTx, ManyRx and SingleDay. Historical Phase1/compact IQ may remain query-only in this explicitly new Full benchmark; old received payloads/results are untouched. This is not an independent blind test or proof of absence from every historical experiment.
date_allocation: Maximum-minimum balance subject to exact available counts, reserve all domains fresh support first, then all queries; integer proportional transportation across domains. Same physical assignment for every method/model/path; no class-conditioned channel probabilities.
preprocessing: Existing eq1 first256 samples; transpose N,256,2 to N,2,256 and FP32, original unit-RMS rule once before fixed practical residual. No recrop, extra EQ, model access or target statistical fit.
storage: Each RX/domain/N capsule has shared mixed-order query IQ/opaque IDs and one actual-K support file per split. Future registered classes and unused support candidates are absent from the current capsule/row reader.
